newsitem.title: CANADA: Inco to license process from Sumitomo.
newsitem.headline: Inco to license process from Sumitomo.

text.p: Canadian nickel producer Inco Ltd said on Wednesday it agreed in principle to license a nickel and cobalt refining process from Japan's Sumitomo Metal Mining Co Ltd.

Under the agreement, Sumitomo would license its patented matte chlorine leach electrowinning (MCLE) process to Inco for use in the refining of nickel and cobalt from Inco's Voisey's Bay deposit in Labrador, Inco said.

"The Sumitomo MCLE process, when combined with Inco's own proprietary flash smelting technology, will allow us to develop a state-of-the-art processing facility from an environmental standpoint, producing high quality nickel and copper products," Inco Chief Executive Michael Sopko said in a statement.
"The combination of these technologies will also provide for the highest overall recovery of nickel and cobalt from the Voisey's Bay deposit," Sopko said.
Inco said it and and Sumitomo expected to enter into a definitive license agreement over the next month.
